definitions.gloss: worth listening to; satisfying to hear
definitions.explanation: The quality of being musically or verbally impressive and rewarding to listen to.

examples.japanese: この{曲|きょく}は{聞|き}き{応|ごた}えがある。
examples.english: This song is worth listening to.

examples.japanese: {聞|き}き{応|ごた}えのある{講演|こうえん}だった。
examples.english: It was a satisfying lecture to listen to.

examples.japanese: オーケストラの{演奏|えんそう}は{聞|き}き{応|ごた}え{十分|じゅうぶん}だった。
examples.english: The orchestra's performance was truly impressive to hear.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{聞|き}く (to listen) + {応|こた}え (response/worth) → worth listening to

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{聞|き}き{応|ごた}えがある (is worth listening to)
・{聞|き}き{応|ごた}えのある{音楽|おんがく} (music worth listening to)
・{聞|き}き{応|ごた}え{十分|じゅうぶん} (fully satisfying to listen to)

RELATED ～{応|ごた}え WORDS:
・{読|よ}み{応|ごた}え (worth reading)
・{見応|みごた}え (worth seeing)
・{歯応|はごた}え (chewiness; challenge)
・{手応|てごた}え (response; feedback)

USAGE:
Used for music, speeches, lectures, podcasts—any audio content that provides depth and satisfaction.
